defs.def: a marriage ceremony, and the meal or party that usually follows it 婚礼；结婚庆典

ex.s: One August afternoon, I sat in my kitchen staring at a glass vase that hadn’t seen daylight since my wedding.
ex.t: 八月的一个下午，我坐在厨房里，盯着一只自婚礼以来就再没见过天日的玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: Tanya is also looking beyond special-occasion dresses to less formal clothing, ___63___ she plans to package as capsule wardrobes and offer to travellers, such as those headed to weddings abroad, with a longer-term rental period.
ex.t: 塔尼娅还将目光投向了正式场合礼服之外的更休闲服装，___63___她计划打包成胶囊衣橱，提供给前往国外参加婚礼等场合的旅客，租期更长。

ex.s: To all, I wish a pleasant trip, to groups off for a family wedding in Singapore, to seniors travelling to Rome for holiday, to children off to Disney World in Orlando...the airport is not a dull place.
ex.t: 对所有人，我都祝愿旅途愉快——无论是去新加坡参加家庭婚礼的团队，还是去罗马度假的老人，或是去奥兰多迪士尼世界的孩子们……机场不是一个沉闷的地方。

ex.s: "We even had a bride in her wedding dress come up to the board and take a few dollars." Most of the bills on the board were singles, but a few people left fives, tens and even twenties.
ex.t: "我们甚至有一位穿着婚纱的新娘走上前拿了几美元。"板上的大部分钞票是一美元的，但有些人留下了五美元、十美元甚至二十美元。

ex.s: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties and just to fill the time.
ex.t: 我们在婚礼、生日聚会和办公室派对上跳舞，或者只是为了打发时间。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 借助3D打印机，厨师可以打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和用于婚礼蛋糕装饰的精美部件。并非人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让这一切变得简单……

ex.s: Yes, there beneath the leafy top of one tiny carrot was her long-lost wedding ring.
ex.t: 是的，在一棵小胡萝卜绿叶覆盖的顶端下面，是她丢失已久的结婚戒指。

ex.s: He was even shocked at their wedding when he saw how the Chinese ate almost every part of an animal.
ex.t: 甚至在他们的婚礼上，当他看到中国人几乎吃掉动物身上每个部位时，他感到震惊。

ex.s: Invitation Traditionally, people send written invitations for formal events such as weddings.
ex.t: 邀请函 传统上，人们会为婚礼等正式场合发送书面邀请函。

ex.s: After the wedding, I left the church slowly behind my aunt and her husband.
ex.t: 婚礼结束后，我跟着姨妈和她的丈夫，缓缓离开了教堂。

ex.s: The bank note was then useless for money but was his wedding gift to the young couple.
ex.t: 那张钞票已不能作为货币使用，却是他送给这对年轻夫妇的结婚礼物。

ex.s: You can use the cards for any special occasion: weddings, births, anniversaries, Christmas, etc.
ex.t: 这些卡片可用于任何特殊场合：婚礼、出生、纪念日、圣诞节等。
